verses.gurmukhi: ੨੦ : ਦੁਸ਼ਟਤਾਈ ਭਲਯਾਈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ ਤਿਲ ਸਣ ਤੇ ਕਪਾਹ
verses.translit_en: 20 : dhushaTataiee bhalayaiee dhirashaTaa(n)t til san te kapaah

en.bdb: Examples on knavery and goodness-sesame seed, hemp and cotton  , ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਫੁਲੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟਾ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: til kaalaa ful ujalaa hariaa booTaa kiaa neesaanee|

en.bdb: How wonderful it is that the sesame seed is black its flower white and plant is green.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਢਹੁ ਵਢਿ ਬਣਾਈਐ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਮਝਿ ਬਿਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: muddahu vadd banaieeaai sir talavaiaa majh bibaanee|

en.bdb: Cutting it from near the root, it is put upsidedown in heap out in the field.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਾਈ ਝੰਬੀਐ ਤੇਲੁ ਤਿਲੀਹੂੰ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: kar kaT paiee jha(n)beeaai tel tileehoo(n) peeRe ghaanee|

en.bdb: First it is thrashed on stone and then the sesame seeds are crushed through an oil press. Hemp and cotton have two ways.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਣ ਕਪਾਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: san kapaeh dhui raeh kar paraupakaar vikaar viddaanee|

en.bdb: One undertakes to perform benevolence and the other feels greatness in adopting evil propensities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਿ ਕਤਾਇ ਵੁਣਾਈਐ ਪੜਦਾ ਕਜਣ ਕਪੜੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: vel katai vunaieeaai paRadhaa kajan kapaR praanee|

en.bdb: From cotton, after ginning and spinning, cloth is prepared which covers nudity of the people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਲ ਕਢਾਇ ਵਟਾਇ ਸਣ ਰਸੇ ਬੰਨੑਹਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: khal kaddai vaTai san rase ba(n)n(h)hin man saramaanee|

en.bdb: Hemp gets its skin peeled off and then ropes are made of it which feel no shame in binding the people.
Knavery of the knaves is just like guests. It has to depart soon.
